description: 卡罗-坎恩推进变例 B12 — c5反制练习：选择正确的反击方向

intro.popup_en:
Counterattack the Center, Practice 7
In the Caro-Kann Advance, White closes the center with e5. Black has several counterplay options. Should Black challenge with ...c5 or ...e5, and why?
intro.popup:
反制中心练习7

卡罗-坎恩推进变例！

e5关链中心后
黑方有多条反制路线

练习目标：
选择正确的反制方向
c5还是e5？为什么？

outro.popup_en: Key plans in the Advance Variation: ...c5 breaks against d4 and opens the center; ...Bb4 or ...Ba5 creates complications; and a bishop on d4 plus a knight on c5 can occupy strong central squares. Choose a counterattack based on piece coordination and central control.
outro.popup:
推进变例总结

关键策略要点：
① c5爆破d4：打开中心
② Bb4/Ba5象机动：增加复杂性
③ Bd4象占中心 + Nc5马关键格

判断依据：
棋子协调性 + 中心控制

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center.
...c6 begins the Caro-Kann Defense.
d4 reinforces White's center.
...d5 challenges the center.
e5! The Advance Variation closes the center.
moves.popup:
e5！推进变例
关链中心

moves.popup_en: ...Bf5 develops the bishop outside the pawn chain.
Nf3 develops a knight.
...e6 reinforces Black's center.
Be2 develops the bishop.
...c5! Black counterattacks against the base of White's chain on d4, seeking to open the center.
Be3 develops the bishop and supports the center.
...cxd4 exchanges pawns in the center.
Nxd4 recaptures and centralizes the knight.
...Nc6 develops a knight and increases pressure on the center.
Nxc6 simplifies by exchanging the knight.
...bxc6 recaptures and leaves Black with a pawn on c6.
O-O secures White's king.
...Bb4! The bishop becomes active and adds complications.
moves.popup:
Bb4！象出击
增加复杂性

moves.popup_en: Nd2 maneuvers the knight, preparing to support b3 or c4.
moves.popup:

moves.popup_en: ...Ba5 retreats while maintaining pressure.
moves.popup:
Ba5 象撤退

moves.popup_en: Nb3 attacks the bishop on a5.
...Bc7 returns to defend important squares.
moves.popup:
Bc7 象回防

moves.popup_en: Nc5! The knight occupies a key square and threatens b7 and d7.

moves.popup_en: c3! White reinforces the center and restricts Black's d5 and c6 squares.
